g.text: JP2: use LOW for all eight gains and startup.

g.desc: JP2: use LOW for all eight gains and startup.

g.text: I2C init: reg 0x01=0x00 BEFORE reg 0x03=0xF0; then reg 0x50=0x40.

g.desc: I2C init: reg 0x01=0x00 BEFORE reg 0x03=0xF0; then reg 0x50=0x40.

g.text: 4.7k pull-downs select unity before initialization. Unused P3 is output LOW.

g.desc: 4.7k pull-downs select unity before initialization. Unused P3 is output LOW.

g.text: Use LOW bandwidth for gains 1, 2.5 and 5.02. See README for timing.

g.desc: Use LOW bandwidth for gains 1, 2.5 and 5.02. See README for timing.

g.text: VMID = VS/2: 1.65 V at 3.3 V; 2.5 V at 5 V

g.desc: VMID = VS/2: 1.65 V at 3.3 V; 2.5 V at 5 V

g.text: VOUT_RAW = VREF + G x (VIN+ - VIN-). REF source drives ALL divider returns.

g.desc: VOUT_RAW = VREF + G x (VIN+ - VIN-). REF source drives ALL divider returns.

g.text: C3-C6 and R9/R10 are DNP. C7 is FITTED. Change supply/reference jumpers with power off.

g.desc: C3-C6 and R9/R10 are DNP. C7 is FITTED. Change supply/reference jumpers with power off.

g.text: Keep sensor, reference and output voltages within analog supply rails. Host VIO and analog VS may differ.

g.desc: Keep sensor, reference and output voltages within analog supply rails. Host VIO and analog VS may differ.

g.text: Power-up: unity, LOW bandwidth, MID reference. Wait 50 ms after power-up; discard samples after gain changes.

g.desc: Power-up: unity, LOW bandwidth, MID reference. Wait 50 ms after power-up; discard samples after gain changes.

g.text: AD8237 | EIGHT I2C GAINS | REV C

g.desc: AD8237 | EIGHT I2C GAINS | REV C

g.text: ANALOG POWER: 3.3 V nominal / 5 V option

g.desc: ANALOG POWER: 3.3 V nominal / 5 V option

g.text: I2C LOGIC DOMAIN - power VIO at the host I/O voltage

g.desc: I2C LOGIC DOMAIN - power VIO at the host I/O voltage
